decoder.mechanism: preserve the frozen seeded area-balanced two-means handoff, then apply bidirectional high-margin wrong-side micro-flips with independent per-direction area and count caps
decoder.decision: a group changes tier only when it is closer to the opposite area-weighted center, and top-to-bottom and bottom-to-top moves are budgeted separately so one direction cannot consume
decoder.prediction: timing-weighted cut and combined score should improve where the parent one-sided micro-flip left boundary groups unbalanced, with smaller cross-seed regressions than a single share
decoder.falsifier: matched official combined score fails to improve while the selected bidirectional flips are present or the timing-weighted cut does not fall.
